title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch. Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership. What We're Looking For The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context . You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner. Must-have experience: Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation). Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards. Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments. Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies. Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts. Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content. AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies. Strong signals we look for: Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context. Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic. Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users. A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise. A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus. How you work: Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities. Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good. Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces. AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work. title: Founding UI/UX Artist, Unannounced Game
description: This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social. As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey! Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell. What You'll Be Doing UX flow design for entire game experience Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance Discover and manage external partners where needed What You Have 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists Passionate about both UI & UX design Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.) Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge. title: Global Clinic Operations Lead
description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose Neko is scaling fast. Our clinical teams already outnumber HQ across the US and Europe, and that ratio will keep growing. They deliver Neko’s promise to every member, every day – and right now, the information supporting their work is fragmented, inconsistent, and ungoverned. At our current pace, that's not just operational noise. It's a quality and safety risk. The role exists to fix that. The role sits at the centre of two funnels. Inbound: you'll work closely with every team at Neko to shape what reaches clinical staff, when, and how. That means building trusted relationships across the organisation, helping teams understand what clinical staff need, and together making deliberate decisions about what gets communicated, what waits, and what can be consolidated. Outbound: once aligned and prioritised, you translate that into structured, cadenced formats that a dispersed clinical workforce can act on – right channel, right format, right frequency. This is change management as much as communications. You're not just sending updates. You're redesigning how the whole organisation relates to its clinical teams. What you'll deliver in the first 6-12 months Build and enforce the intake model Design the process that governs how every team at Neko communicates with clinical staff – how requests are submitted, evaluated, sequenced, and approved Build the centralised view that ensures nothing reaches clinical staff in an uncoordinated or duplicative way Document decision criteria clearly enough that stakeholders understand and trust how calls are made Define escalation paths for urgent communications that need to move faster than the standard cadence Drive organisation-wide change management Partner with senior leadership to establish the intake model as an endorsed, org-wide norm – not an optional service, but the way Neko works Run a structured roll-out across every team with touch points to clinical staff Build the relationships that make the process feel collaborative rather than bureaucratic Report regularly on intake volume, team compliance, and where we need to evolve. Operationalise clinical communications Start with a clear-eyed audit of how information reaches clinical teams today – the gaps, the overlaps, the friction Build a global clinical programme with a single source of truth that clinical staff can rely on Design the right mix of channels and formats for a dispersed, non-desk workforce – including AI-enabled formats like short-form video, audio briefings, and visual summaries Create repeatable templates that make consistency straightforward for programme managers and local teams Equip clinic leads with the tools and confidence to communicate well within their teams without losing global coherence Define the metrics that prove it's working – comprehension, consistency, engagement, reduction in operational noise – and report on them regularly Build a global communications cadence that helps leadership teams understand what’s changing, what’s ahead and how to prepare. Minimum Qualifications Proven experience in change management, or programme management, with direct ownership of communication or enablement strategy at scale Proven experience designing and enforcing intake or governance processes across multiple cross-functional teams – you've built the model, sold it in, and made it stick A track record running structured communications programmes for large, dispersed frontline workforces Strong programme management instincts: you bring structure to ambiguity and build systems that hold A creative communicator who knows when a policy document is right and when a 60-second video does the job better Genuine fluency with AI tools and an appetite to use them to improve quality, efficiency, and reach Sharp stakeholder skills: you can align leadership and cross-functional teams, hold the line when needed, and build trust in the process Experience in high-growth, multi-site consumer services or healthcare strongly preferred Comfortable working across multiple geographies and time zones Strong written and verbal English; additional European languages a plus About titles at Neko We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: The Senior Security Engineer – Enterprise Security shares ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Samsara security environment. Executive leadership actively champions security as a competitive advantage that builds customer trust and helps win enterprise partnerships. Our on-call rotation for the highest severity incidents is spread evenly across the team for one week out of every ten. documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar) Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems, email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM) An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms Strong familiarity with across teams An ideal candidate also has: Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments. title: Enterprise Account Executive UK&I (Remote UK&I)
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to win and grow Enterprise customers by becoming the trusted partner of technical teams and their leaders. As an Enterprise Account Executive covering UK&I (United Kingdom & Ireland), you will own a territory of larger organisations and drive complex deals from first conversation to signature: GENERATE NEW-LOGO PIPELINE Build and execute account plans for named Enterprise accounts with 1,001 to 5,000 employees. Run outbound campaigns that open doors with CTOs, engineering leaders and platform teams. Turn community adoption and inbound signals into structured enterprise opportunities. LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-STAKEHOLDER DEALS Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build a business case with your champions. Map decision makers across engineering, IT, security and procurement and keep every thread alive. Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical evaluations and proofs of concept. CLOSE AND EXPAND Own the sales cycle through security, legal and procurement reviews, typically over two to four months. Negotiate with confidence and keep clear commercial control of next steps. Hand over to Customer Success and plan expansion across teams and use cases. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves 🏢 Enterprise SaaS sales: You have sold B2B SaaS into organisations of roughly 1,001 to 5,000 employees and can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length. 🧑‍💻 Technical buyers: You have sold to developers, engineers, CTOs, CIOs and DevOps or platform teams, and you explain complex products without leaning on a Solutions Engineer. 🧩 Complex deals: You have run multi-stakeholder cycles of two to four months and closed meaningful deals in organisations of 1,001 to 5,000 employees. 🎯 New-logo hunter: You generate your own pipeline through outbound and win new customers rather than living off expansion or inbound. 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years. 🧭 Structured selling: You use a structured methodology (MEDDPICC or similar is a plus) and navigate technical evaluations, procurement, legal and security reviews. 📍 Location: You are based in United Kingdom or Ireland and you already have the right to work there. This role covers the UK&I territory and involves regular travel to customers in the region. Nice-to-haves 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms. 🚀 Startup or open-source exposure: You have worked at an open-source, product-led or Series A to C company. 🤝 Technical network: You already know engineering and IT leaders in your territory. Why join us? You will win Enterprise customers with a product technical teams already love, and you will help define how we sell to larger organisations as the segment takes shape. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Partnerships and Product, so your voice carries weight. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the world’s most ambitious companies. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. title: Director of Global HR Business Partnering
description: <p><strong>Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company! </strong></p> <p>Operating from our London office, the Global Director of HR Business Partnering will lead and manage the global HRBP function through the Regional Directors of HR, while owning and executing the HR roadmap for the global Growth Sales business group, with the same partnering responsibilities as other HRBPs.<br><br>You will help leaders make sound people and organisation decisions and enable Taboolars to do their best work. Bring judgement, business knowledge, relationships and delivery to work that cannot be automated, handled by managers alone or delivered at scale by shared services. Offer an independent commercial view, ensure fair and consistent treatment, and be approachable to employees. Credibility comes from balancing these responsibilities.</p> <p><strong>To thrive in this role, you'll need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience leading global teams (including managing managers) across locations, a clear standard for great HR partnering and the ability to bring all HRBPs to that standard.</li> <li>Strong global ER experience and judgement, including when to seek advice or hand over.</li> <li>Strong business understanding; the ability to identify underlying issues and patterns, beyond what you are told, and make independent, well-reasoned recommendations.</li> <li>Sound operating-model judgement and the ability to distinguish performance from potential in making fair decisions.</li> <li>To be someone who views AI and automation as the ultimate leverage for HR. You don’t need to be a data scientist, but you should be someone who reads about LLMs, experiments with productivity tools, and dreams of an HR department where technology handles the routine so people can handle the exceptional </li> <li>Confidence to influence, challenge constructively, reset expectations with senior leaders and support the team.</li> <li>Emotional and cultural intelligence, care for people, and judgement that balances commercial, legal, people and organisational considerations.</li> <li>Ability to embed change and follow through after decisions.</li> <li>Experience of effective collaboration with operations and analytics to deliver at scale, and across time zones and legal systems: acknowledge knowledge gaps and work through regional colleagues.</li> <li>Clear judgement on when to step in and when work belongs elsewhere.</li> <li>Experience of implementing AI and automation for routine work, rethinking how work is done as well as digitising it.</li> <li>A collaborative approach that strengthens the whole People Ops team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p> <p>As a Director of Global HR Business Partnering you’ll bring value by:<br><br>Leading the Global HRBP Department:</p> <ul> <li>Set priorities, ways of working and the standard for good partnering; build a high-performing team people want to join. Own capability, development and careers across the team.</li> <li>Coach the team on ER cases, deferring to the Employee Relations Centres of Expertise (CoEs) for more complex matters.</li> <li>Allocate HRBP capacity across global and regional responsibilities according to region and business-group size and complexity.</li> <li>Ensure HRBP role clarity by setting up and upholding boundaries between HR BPs, managers, the Shared Service Centre (SSC), Internal Operations and CoEs.</li> <li>Own the HR BP contribution to annual people processes by ensuring prepared HR BPs, consistent communication and effective support for leaders.</li> <li>Own HR BP headcount and budget.</li> <li>Be accountable for improving productivity, retaining critical talent, developing capable managers, embedding change and improving people and organisation decisions.</li> </ul> <p>Managing your own HRBP Responsiblitlies:</p> <p>VP partnership and global remit:</p> <ul> <li>Sit on your VP’s leadership team, agree functional people priorities and remain their main HR contact when involving regional colleagues or specialists. Understand their strategy, commercial pressures, obstacles and organisation; anticipate people issues and offer your own view.</li> <li>Take a global view of the function’s strategy, structure, talent, annual cycles and patterns. Lead performance, talent review and calibration, and compensation cycles from start to finish: manage and allocate budgets, maintain regional consistency, run calibration, handle exceptions and agree dates within global timelines. Regional HR BPs help local managers prepare proposals and provide market context; you lead the process and support the VP’s final decisions.</li> </ul> <p>Talent and organisation advice:</p> <ul> <li>Advise on talent, performance, workforce and structure, including succession, critical-talent retention, promotions, calibration, team design and accountability. Interpret data from People Analytics & Data Insights and recommend action linked to business needs.</li> </ul> <p>Manager capability and change:</p> <ul> <li> Help managers interpret people data rather than producing it, and use your judgment to provide insights and inform good decision making <br>Coach managers through matters they can handle themselves, rather than taking over, building their confidence and capability.<br>Put decisions into practice: explain the context, support leaders and look after people through change.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Taboola?</strong></p> <p>If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:</p> <ul> <li>Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.</li> <li><strong>Well-being:</strong> With an office culture that’s international, social and supportive, Taboola offers very generous benefits including 20 days holiday, excellent health insurance, some flexible working, and stock options to name just a few.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility: </strong>We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.</li> <li><strong>Work with some of the biggest names: </strong>We work with some of the biggest names in the business. Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Database Focus)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.<br><br>We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit<span><a href="http://www.gocardless.com" target="_blank"> www.gocardless.com</a></span> and follow us on LinkedIn<span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gocardless" target="_blank"> ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.</p></div><h3><strong>Platform Engineering at GoCardless</strong></h3> <p>The Platform Engineering team is a unified, globally distributed team, currently located in London, Riga and Lisbon. We work with all other engineering teams to empower them to build, release, run and scale their products, with a strong focus on both strategic project delivery and operational excellence.</p> <p><strong>Our work is a balance of:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Project delivery:</strong> building new platform components, from initial design to deployment.</li> <li><strong>Operational support:</strong> keeping our systems healthy and stable through on-call rotations and incident management.</li> <li><strong>Business as usual:</strong> continuous maintenance, improvements, and support for audits and compliance.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The role</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for a Senior SRE with deep PostgreSQL expertise to own the reliability, performance and scalability of our database estate. Our databases sit at the heart of a payments platform, so slowdowns and outages directly affect our customers.</p> <p>You’ll work across our self-managed Stolon clusters and our GCP Cloud SQL fleet. Joining Mollie gives us the opportunity to consolidate, modularise and rethink how we run production databases, and you’ll help us do that while keeping everything reliable.</p> <p><strong>What excites you  </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Run our database fleet reliably.</strong> Keep our production databases healthy and stable through significant change, including moves between platforms.</li> <li><strong>Own performance and capacity.</strong> Right-size instances, tune connection limits and pooling (PgBouncer), memory and autovacuum settings, and fix slow queries, N+1s and unused indexes before customers feel them.</li> <li><strong>Own upgrades and change.</strong> Lead major-version database upgrades end to end with minimal downtime, and own safe schema migrations, data migrations and backfills.</li> <li><strong>Build in resilience.</strong> Reduce idle-in-transaction sessions, tighten statement timeouts, and design and test failover, replication and backup and recovery.</li> <li><strong>Make it observable.</strong> Build dashboards and alerts in Grafana, Prometheus and Datadog to track saturation, latency and connection health.</li> <li><strong>Partner with application teams.</strong> Help them use their databases well and improve their query patterns.</li> <li><strong>Respond and learn.</strong> Take part in on-call, mitigate live database incidents, and run root cause analyses to prevent repeats.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What excites us</strong></p> <h4><strong>Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Typically 5+ years of production experience running PostgreSQL, including high availability, replication, and backup and recovery</li> <li>Deep knowledge of Postgres performance and tuning: internals (memory settings, autovacuum, locking) and connection pooling, including managing it in production and supporting it on call</li> <li>Experience running production databases in the cloud, whether on managed services or self-managed on cloud infrastructure</li> <li>Strong query analysis skills (EXPLAIN plans, indexing strategy)</li> <li>Experience running major-version upgrades safely with minimal downtime</li> <li>Experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar IaC tooling</li> <li>Experience with monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or similar)</li> <li>Experience writing code/working in software engineering teams</li> <li>Experience with on-call and incident response</li> <li>Ability to influence application teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with<a href="https://github.com/gocardless/stolon"> Stolon</a>, or similar Postgres HA tooling</li> <li>Experience with managed cloud Postgres (GCP CloudSQL, AWS RDS etc.)</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes, GKE and ArgoCD</li> <li>Experience migrating databases between platforms</li> <li>Experience with SLOs and error budgets</li> <li>Experience in payments or financial services</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Why it matters</strong></h4> <p>We hope you’re enthusiastic about the infrastructure space and the impact your work can have on others. In this role:</p> <ul> <li>You’ll work on a core system with direct, measurable impact on the reliability of the payments.</li> <li>You’ll solve hard performance and reliability problems in systems that matter.</li> <li>You’ll shape our database approach at a pivotal moment, as joining Mollie opens up choices about how we structure our estate.</li> <li>You’ll have real influence on technical design and decisions, and the chance to raise the bar for those around you.</li> <li>You’ll work closely with application teams and build easy-to-understand, maintainable tools and automation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Tech stack and tools</strong></h3> <ul> <li>PostgreSQL, Stolon, Cloud SQL, PgBouncer</li> <li>Python, Ruby, Golang</li> <li>Terraform, Atlantis</li> <li>GCP</li> <li>Kubernetes, GKE</li> <li>GitHub, ArgoCD</li> <li>Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog</li> </ul> <p>We use a wide range of technologies and will never expect you to have experience with all of them.</p> <p>Base salary range: <strong>£62,000 - £108,000</strong></p> <p>Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>(some of) The good stuff</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Wellbeing </strong>- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover</li> <li><strong>Lunch</strong>- based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office</li> <li><strong>Work away scheme</strong> - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period</li> <li><strong>Adaptive Working</strong> - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle</li> <li><strong>Parental leave</strong> - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure</li> <li><strong>Learning Budget</strong> - lead your own development with an annual learning budget</li> <li><strong>Time off</strong> - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house</li> </ul> <h3><strong style="font-size: 14px;">Life at GoCardless  </strong></h3> <p>We're an organisation defined by our<a href="https://gocardless.com/g/values-operating-principles/" target="_blank"> <u>values</u></a>; We <strong><em>start with why</em></strong><em> </em>before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We <strong><em>make it happen</em></strong>, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We<strong><em> act with integrity</em></strong>, always. We <strong><em>care deeply</em></strong> about what we do and we know it's essential that we <strong><em>be humble </em></strong>whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision. </p> <h4><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h4> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — <strong>25%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Neurodiverse — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">LGBTQIA+ — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Disabled — <strong>1%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Average age — <strong>33</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Female — <strong>45%</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Male — <strong> 55% </strong></p> <p>We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make

title: Lead Product Designer
description: Lead Product Designer 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 💰 £70k-£90k (negotiable) Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer - the most senior individual contributor for design within a product domain. This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk. We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK. If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you. At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them. Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask. We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping. Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L6 Lead Product Designer at Street Group Own the design vision and execution for a product domain. Translate strategic direction into the most ambiguous, cross-cutting, or strategically important pieces of design work. Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like in your area. Own the cross-cutting design problems: patterns across multiple features, flows across multiple surfaces, the coherence of the domain's experience as a whole. Mentor and raise the bar of the designers around you - through critique, pairing, and modelling what excellent design looks like. Drive AI thinking strategically - both in your own workflow (Claude Code, in-product changes, prototype testing) and in what we ship to users. You'll have a strong view on what makes a good AI feature in this domain vs a gimmicky one. Why you should (and shouldn't) apply You should apply if: You've operated at senior IC level in a modern product org and you want broader scope to influence what gets built. You're commercially fluent. You've made design trade-offs informed by how the product makes money, not just by user preference. You can name those trade-offs and defend them either way. You define what success looks like before you ship, and you read the result against it after. Metrics, support data, customer feedback - you go and look. You have strong, well-formed views on AI in product design and have put them into practice. You can articulate when AI is the right design solution and when it isn't. You move at pace on strategic work, not just on features. You probably shouldn't apply if: You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role. Lead expects materially more scope, autonomy, judgment, and ownership of outcomes. You've never shipped design work where you defined a success measure upfront and checked the result afterwards. We need someone who already operates that way. You've never had to make a commercial trade-off - design that's user-optimal but expensive to build, or design that doesn't move retention. You'd struggle to explain how AI is changing what you ship, not just how you work. AI fluency is non-negotiable at this level. You expect to be handed a brief. At L6 you identify what's worth doing and bring the case for it. A bit about you Experience: Roughly 8+ years of Product/UX Design experience, with a track record at senior IC level. SaaS or complex product experience is strongly preferred. Outcomes, not artefacts: You can point to design work you've shipped where you wrote the success measure upfront and read the result after release. You know what worked, what didn't, and what you'd do differently. Commercial fluency: You understand how the products you've worked on make money and you've made trade-offs informed by that. AI: Comfortable using AI across your workflow and equally comfortable thinking strategically about AI in the products you design - what makes a good AI feature, what the failure modes are, what to build now vs later. Craft: Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. You have views on interaction quality, hierarchy, motion, microcopy - and you can defend them. Cross-functional: Comfortable as a peer at the table with product and engineering counterparts in your domain. Drive direction; don't wait for it. Open to flex: This is predominantly an IC role, but we're not rigid about it. If you've line-managed before, or want to take on one or two direct reports alongside the IC work, we're open to that conversation. Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application. Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) 💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth 📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development 🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away 🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay 🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured 🧘 Regular well-being initiatives 🕒 Flexible working hours 🚂 Public transport season ticket loans 🌷 Paid menopause leave 🌞 Holiday buying scheme 🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition 👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day 👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology 🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome! 🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon 🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours 🚴 Cycle to work scheme 🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme 🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company! Salary We don't have a fixed band published for this role yet - it'll be calibrated based on your experience and scope. Please apply and let's have the conversation. We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. title: Delivery Manager
description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. In our Professional and Financial Services Business unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI, and use it to help our clients navigate a rapidly changing landscape. We develop and embed AI solutions which help firms become more efficient, enhance customer experience, and find the commercial upside in uncertain markets. Within the constraints of a highly regulated industry, we see so much opportunity for meaningful innovation and are proud to set the gold-standard for marrying technical excellence with safe deployment. About the role As a delivery manager, you’ll own the end-to-end success of high-impact AI projects for our clients. You will be the crucial link between our customers and technical teams, ensuring on-time delivery, maximising value, and cultivating strong relationships which position Faculty as the partner of choice for future AI projects. What you'll be doing: Owning the end-to-end delivery of customer projects, from initial scoping to final implementation Collaborating with technical teams, and customers, to design innovative AI solutions that solve their challenges and leverage opportunities Managing project development and ensuring a delivery approach that provides maximum value to the customer Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers, acting as the primary point of contact throughout the project lifecycle Identifying new commercial opportunities and contributing to new business pitches and proposals Developing and mentoring your peers’ taking a proactive role in building good processes and practices Who we're looking for: You have previous experience in professional services, ideally from a consulting, technology, or data background You take full responsibility for the successful delivery of your projects, from initial scoping to end-user adoption You are an exceptional communicator, with outstanding written and verbal skills, and experience managing senior stakeholders You are comfortable working with technical teams and have experience delivering technical projects, ideally in AI You are a practical problem-solver, identifying potential issues and proactively implementing solutions Our Interview Process Talent Team Screen (30 mins) Introduction Interview (45 mins) Case Study Interview (90 mins) Final Interview (30 mins) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI. title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. We're looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to help lead technically across our frontend engineering. You'll work across a group of cross-functional squads, each made up of engineers, designers, data analysts and a product manager, helping them move quickly and safely, resolving the engineering problems that span teams before they compound into systemic risk, and shaping product and business strategy with a technically-grounded, commercially-aware point of view. We're a TypeScript-first organisation. Our frontend stack is TypeScript and React, styled with SCSS, server-side rendered with Next.js and Express, and tested with Vitest & Chromatic. As a Staff engineer you'll bring deep expertise with the latest native web technologies and modern frameworks, drive consistency across all of our web properties, and lead the migration efforts that keep our stack current, not just bumping versions, but making use of the new capabilities each release brings and helping the wider department do the same. At Motorway, we know the importance of delivering high-quality, valuable solutions quickly, and we recognise the ability for AI tools and agents to accelerate our work. We provide our engineers with access to the latest models through Kiro. As a Staff engineer you'll define and lead our AI engineering practice on the frontend, setting standards for agent execution environments, quality harnesses, and guardrail architecture - and build a team norm where domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous feedback-loop design are treated as complementary. What you'll be doing Ship features end to end : Own meaningful pieces of product work from design handoff through to production, building accessible, performant components, wiring them into applications, and shipping them with confidence. Author the contracts and the roadmap : Author and own API contracts and documentation for the department, and maintain a technical roadmap with rigorous written framing - precise intent, explicit trade-offs, and unambiguous success criteria - setting the documentation and spec-writing standard for the area. Drive consistency and lead migrations : Drive consistency across all our web properties, design the standards the department builds on, and lead migration efforts - making full use of new framework features and bringing the rest of engineering along with you. Own quality, security, performance and reliability standards : Set and maintain the security & web performance standards for the frontend, including client-side concerns like CSP, CWV, XSS prevention, data, governance plus reliability standards, incident review culture, and production readiness criteria. Own the build and deployment story : Understand the build and deployment pipeline for our assets and services end to end, monitor and improve it, and make informed, commercially-aware decisions about hosting providers, vendors, and build-vs-buy trade-offs. Develop other engineers : Develop IC3 engineers into technical leaders, raise the technical bar in hiring by defining what "good" looks like in the discipline, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and high standards. Lead AI-assisted engineering : Use Kiro and other AI tools to move faster, and set the standards for how the team integrates AI into its everyday workflow and its products. What you'll have Minimum requirements At least 5+ years of experience in focused frontend practice building and operating production web applications at scale, with a track record of leading large, complex projects. The ability to bridge engineering and product fluently, translating between business priorities and technical constraints in both directions, and to make and defend difficult technical decisions under uncertainty through reasoning, not authority. Recognised as a technical authority in frontend engineering - engineers and product stakeholders seek you out for technical direction, and your judgement shapes decisions beyond your immediate team. Deep expertise with modern CSS/SCSS, HTML, and current ECMAScript proposals, and a strong understanding of the trade-offs between different frameworks and the scenarios in which each is the right choice. Comprehensive experience writing unit and E2E tests, and building the CI workflows to exercise them. Deep working knowledge of TypeScript and modern React (hooks, component composition, transitions), and of frameworks like Next.js that handle SSR, routing, and data fetching. Deep experience with observability, Core Web Vitals, accessibility auditing, and frontend performance tuning - and the ability to evaluate new frameworks and identify where we gain an edge in development, deployment, rendering, integration, and performance. Breadth across different teams, and the judgement to make pragmatic build-vs-refactor-vs-replace calls informed by a track record of production crises and scale challenges. A genuine interest in leading AI-assisted development as part of your and the team's workflow. Additional or preferred requirements Experience owning and maintaining a design system, and driving its adoption across multiple teams. The ability to create sensible UI designs without a Designer for non-trivial (though not highly complex) work when the team is resource-constrained. Experience evaluating vendors and third-party tools, and making build-vs-buy recommendations with clear technical and commercial criteria. Experience maintaining and evolving complex legacy systems at scale. Backend fluency - you don't need to be full-stack, but you're comfortable following a request deep into the API layer and shaping the contract on both sides. title: Customer Success Lead
description: 💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. That sounds cool - what does a Customer Success Lead have to do with it? Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs and is growing fast in secondary care. To keep up with how the NHS is organising itself, our Account Management team has just moved to a regional model, with leads for London, the South and the North. The goal is simple: join up what we’re learning across primary care, secondary care, acute, community and mental health, and make sure the best opportunities get surfaced across the whole of England, not just in one set of ICBs. We’re hiring a Customer Success Lead for the North. You’ll lead a team of Customer Success Managers across primary and secondary care and be the strategic, zoomed-out view of the region. Your team is close to the accounts. Your job is to spot the patterns across them, turn what they’re hearing into strategy, and help Accurx show up at a regional level. You’ll coach them, unblock them and help them do the best work of their careers. Bring two very different care settings together. Primary care is about deepening trust we’ve built over years. Secondary care is about firsts: new services, longer implementations and goalposts that move. You’ll work out what connects them, what doesn’t, and where learnings from one can speed up the other. Turn insight into strategy. Your team will feed you what’s happening on the ground. You’ll spot trends, gaps and duplicated effort across the region and turn them into projects, goals and growth opportunities in products like Accurx Scribe and Total Triage. Own the commercial picture for your region. You’ll keep a close eye on churn, risk, renewals and upsell across your team’s accounts, and represent the region at our weekly business reviews with the exec team. Build the playbook with your fellow leads. The regional model is brand new. Alongside the leads for London and the South, you’ll shape how we work, what best practice looks like and how we scale it. Be the link across the business. You’ll work closely with implementation, transformation, support and business development, making sure the voice of our customers shapes where Accurx goes next. You should apply if... You’ve led customer-facing teams. You have a few years of people management in customer success or account management, and you love helping others grow. You’ve built things from the ground up. You’ve been on a startup to scale-up journey, worn a lot of hats, and taken customers from never having heard of you to being your biggest advocates. You care about depth, not volume. You’ve looked after long-standing, strategic relationships rather than a high-volume queue, and you know that trust is what makes customers stick. You can zoom out. You don’t need to be in the weeds of every account. You’re great at spotting patterns, asking the right questions and knowing where your team needs you most. You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You’re happy to try something, get it wrong, learn and go again. Process is something you create, not something you wait for. You’re a big collaborator. You’re an incredible communicator and listener, and you know the best outcomes come from working across teams. You’re curious about the NHS. Healthcare experience is welcome but not essential. What matters is empathy for the pressure the NHS is under and the patience to build trust in a complex system. What’s in it for you? Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London | 💰 £60k – £80k base salary | £100k – £135k OTE + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Benefits</a></p> <h3><strong>Our Monzo Business team ⭐</strong></h3> <p>Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than a million businesses (1 in 6!) in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe 🚀</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. Now we’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives and help us turn what we’re learning into a repeatable, effective sales motion.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll coach your team, help them deliver great results and use what you see every day to make the way we sell better. You’ll work closely with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Product and other teams to improve our processes and customer journeys.</p> <p>You’ll also help build an AI-first sales motion from the start. We want someone who’s curious about AI and automation, actively experiments with new tools and can help the team spend more time on conversations that matter.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a team of Account Executives.</strong> Manage a pod of 6–8 people and be accountable for its performance, from reaching the right businesses and converting opportunities to customer activation and quality. Translate the wider Business strategy and set clear expectations, understand what’s driving results and act when performance needs to improve.</li> <li><strong>Coaching and developing your team.</strong> Spend time listening to calls, reviewing opportunities and giving clear, regular feedback. Help each person build their skills and confidence, recognise great work and address underperformance fairly. Help hire and onboard new team members as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Building the sales motion.</strong> Turn what you and your team learn into better ways of working. Spot friction in lead handling, follow-up, handovers and the sales process; test improvements, measure their impact and share what works so we can build a repeatable playbook.</li> <li><strong>Staying close to customers.</strong> We expect Sales Managers to also take a few sales calls each week and make a few sales a month. Use what you learn from customers and the sales journey to coach the team, identify product needs and improve the motion. Most of your time will be spent leading the team and improving how we work.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our Products.</strong> Share what you learn from customers with Product to help shape our proposition and priorities, and use what we learn to improve how we sell.</li> <li><strong>Putting AI and automation to work.</strong> Experiment with tools, agents and workflows that help the team research prospects, prepare for conversations, follow up or learn from calls. Work with specialist teams to test ideas responsibly, understand their impact and help the team adopt what works.</li> <li><strong>Making good decisions with data.</strong> Use pipeline, conversion, activation, productivity and quality data to understand where the team is doing well and where customers or opportunities are getting stuck. Keep the pipeline accurate and work with RevOps on reporting and forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Working as one team.</strong> Bring frontline insight to RevOps, Product, Marketing and Operations. Help shape the tools, processes and customer journeys Sales needs, and work together to solve problems that affect your team and customers.</li> <li><strong>Earning customers’ trust.</strong> Build a culture that puts customers first. Coach your team to understand their needs, represent Monzo accurately and deliver good outcomes. Raise concerns early and work with Risk, Compliance and Legal when needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ve managed and developed a sales team. You can share examples of how you’ve coached individuals, given feedback and improved performance, including when conversations were difficult.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses in a relatively high-volume environment. You can balance an efficient process with thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.</li> <li>You’re a builder. You’ve spotted a problem in how a team sells, tried a better approach and helped people put it into practice. You’re comfortable making progress when the playbook is still being written.</li> <li>You’ve actively experimented with AI or automation at work and are keen to explore what agents and new workflows can do. You can tell us what you tried, the problem you were solving and what you learned.</li> <li>You’re happy to stay hands-on with customers. You enjoy sales conversations yourself and use what you learn to help others improve.</li> <li>You use data to understand performance. You can look at a funnel or pipeline, ask good questions and turn the answers into practical action.</li> <li>You work well with people in different teams. You can explain what your team and customers need, share evidence and help colleagues find solutions together.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers. You’re comfortable working within clear standards and learning what it takes to sell in a regulated environment.</li> <li>You might have built your experience in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get here.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t have everything that’s listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h3><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>💰 £60k – £80k base salary, plus on-target commission based on team performance. Total on-target earnings are approximately £100k – £135k</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office. You’ll work from the office at least 3 days a week to stay close to your team.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></h4> <ul> <li>30-minute introductory call with a recruiter</li> <li>A full interview loop covering role-specific skills, behaviours and values</li> <li>A conversation with a member of the team</li> <li>Final interview with the hiring manager at our London office</li> </ul> <p>We’ll share more details about the interview process and timing as you progress. Your schedule is important to us, so we’ll be as flexible as possible.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><h3>Reporting to: SVP, Corporate Sales - EMEA & APAC</h3> <h3>About The Role:</h3> <p>The EMEA Sales Director, Life Science role is based in the UK, supporting our rapid expansion and recent product launches. In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Inspire and Lead</strong>: As a champion of AlphaSense’s culture and values, you’ll lead a high-performing, diverse team, setting a standard of excellence across EMEA. Embracing our “Better Never Stops” philosophy, you’ll cultivate continuous improvement through strategic coaching, constructive feedback, and development to elevate team potential.</li> <li><strong>Drive Impact</strong>: Foster excellence through developing our people, perfecting our sales operations and optimising processes to exceed our ambitious sales targets. Leverage new product innovations to unlock opportunities and enhance value for new and existing clients, positioning AlphaSense as a trusted market partner.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate for Success</strong>: Partner in a cross-functional environment, working closely with product, marketing, and customer success teams to align on goals, execute collaboratively, and elevate client experiences. By setting clear, shared objectives and encouraging co-ownership, you’ll contribute to a unified approach organisation-wide.</li> </ul> <p>This is an extraordinary opportunity to make a meaningful impact during a period of rapid expansion.</p> <h3>Key Responsiibilties</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Development</strong>: Build, inspire, and lead a high-performance Life Science sales team focused on collaboration, inclusivity, and growth. Foster a supportive, high-accountability environment where feedback, both positive and constructive, is valued to drive development.</li> <li><strong>Sales Strategy & Execution</strong>: Shape and execute an EMEA go-to-market strategy aligned with AlphaSense’s global objectives. Demonstrate strategic vision by identifying growth opportunities, scaling the team’s efforts, and focusing on impactful results.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Management</strong>: Use CRM and analytics tools to track sales metrics, forecast accurately, and make informed decisions that drive continuous improvement. Promote alignment around key KPIs to sustain transparency and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement</strong>: Engage directly with high-value prospects and clients to understand their needs, deliver solutions, and build long-term partnerships. Champion a client-centric approach to foster trust and position AlphaSense as a market leader in EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Market Expansion</strong>: Identify and pursue strategic growth opportunities within EMEA, adapt to evolving market trends, and align with our strategic direction.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong>: Partner with product, marketing, and other teams to drive alignment, create a seamless client journey, and model AlphaSense’s values of open communication and collaboration.</li> </ul> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Sales Leadership</strong>: Successful track record in sales leadership within SaaS or high-growth tech, including building and managing high-performing teams across EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Vision</strong>: A big-picture thinker with a clear growth strategy, able to inspire and unify teams around a shared purpose, and execute with a commitment to excellence.</li> <li><strong>Metrics-Driven Focus</strong>: Proficiency with pipeline management, forecasting, and performance metrics, leveraging CRM and analytics tools for decision-making and enhancing team performance.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Influence</strong>: Skilled in collaborating across departments, engaging key stakeholders, and working with senior leaders to foster co-ownership and shared success.</li> <li><strong>Outstanding Communication</strong>: Strong written and verbal skills, able to articulate vision and inspire both internal teams and clients through open and constructive dialogue.</li> <li><strong>Client-Centric Approach</strong>: Deep understanding of the EMEA market, committed to delivering client value and cultivating long-term, mutually beneficial relationships.</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements and Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Proven record in sales management and leadership, with consistent target overachievement across industries and buyer personas within the life science vertical.</li> <li>Expertise in managing complex SaaS sales cycles, with a focus on continuous sales process optimisation.</li> <li>Skilled in coaching and developing high-performing sales professionals.</li> <li>Effective in cross-functional collaboration with experience in multi-departmental initiatives.</li> <li>Dedicated to feedback and team growth support.</li> <li><strong>Ideal</strong>: Experience in a fast-scaling SaaS environment and selling to research professionals within the Corporate market.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span
