title: STORE MANAGER
description: Are you passionate about fashion and excited to lead the team at Meller’s very first store in the city? With a bold, fresh, and authentic style, at Meller we inspire those who want to stand out. We believe there’s a perfect pair of sunglasses for everyone. What began with a clear vision for design and sustainability has grown into a brand that goes beyond fashion. We focus on connecting, setting trends, and helping people express who they are. We’re seeking an energetic Store Manager with an innovative mindset, a passion for crafting exceptional customer experiences and excitement to join our new store in Fouberts Pl. Your role ● Lead the team and represent the Meller brand, ensuring every customer enjoys a unique in-store experience. ● Set clear goals, foster a sense of shared ownership, and keep the team focused on results and continuous improvement. ● Turn the store into more than just a shop — a space of connection where every visitor experiences the full Meller vibe. ● Oversee daily operations, from inventory to visual standards, ensuring smooth store functionality (POS, deliveries, replenishment, maintenance). ● Monitor stock levels, make adjustments as needed, and maintain an organised, attractive store. ● Ensure promotions and campaigns are executed flawlessly. ● Bring proactive ideas to help the store and brand evolve — your input matters. What we’re looking for ● Minimum 2 years of retail experience, preferably in a leadership role with team management. ● Strategic and analytical mindset to make data-driven decisions using KPIs and sales reports. ● Passion for fashion and a strong interest in the product. ● High level of English, comfortable with international customers. ● Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for sales and KPI analysis. ● Energetic, growth-oriented attitude; a team player who shares our ambitious vision. What we offer ● Full-time permanent contract. ● Exclusive Meller product discounts. ● Growth and training opportunities within the company. ● A work environment where authenticity, creativity, and innovation are at the core. ● Join a dynamic team. Meller is committed to an inclusive selection process. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities, and strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. title: Data Scientist
description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. About the team We don’t build pricing models, we build the driving intelligence that feeds them. Our mission is to drive safer roads and fairer insurance through data. The Telematics team transforms raw phone sensor data into meaningful insights about how people drive. Using advanced signal processing and machine learning, we process high-frequency data to extract behavioural signals that power our understanding of driving quality, context, and risk. About the Role As a Data Scientist, you’ll contribute to the future of behaviour-based insurance. You’ll contribute to the development of features and algorithms that detect driving patterns from sensors, test new hypotheses, and help bring impactful insights into production. You’ll work closely at the intersection of data science and engineering, generating scalable, real-world insights from GPS, accelerometer, and other spatial data. What you will be doing Build and refine behavioural features and factors from telematics data. Develop and maintain end-to-end pipelines in Python and SQL, ranging from simple heuristics to complex machine learning models. Build robust solutions that scale, whether rule-based or ML-driven. Collaborate with Software Engineers,Data Scientists, and Product Managers to implement features and evaluate their impact. Run experiments, test new ideas, and assist in automating insight generation. Translate complex sensor data into clear insights that can shape our roadmap and product. Clear communication skills: able to break down problems into testable hypotheses and collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams. A growth mindset: curious, eager to learn from senior peers, and open to feedback. Nice to Have Exposure to noisy, high-frequency, or time-series sensor data (e.g., GPS, accelerometer). Familiarity with digital signal processing or sensor physics principles. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and tools like Docker or basic pipeline orchestration. Background or interest in insurance, mobile telemetry, or behavioural modeling. Experience applying Deep Learning models to time-series data. title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong> to join our <strong>Star Trek™ Fleet Command</strong> team in London on a hybrid basis.</p> <p>Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <p>As the Senior Product Manager<strong>, </strong>you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.</p> <ul> <li>Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs</li> <li>Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences</li> <li>Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales</li> <li>Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies</li> <li>Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation</li> <li>Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements</li> <li>Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting</li> <li>Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game</li> <li>Demonstrated strategic insights and actionable plans</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision</li> <li>Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels</li> <li>Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams</li> </ul> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!  We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>. </p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. title: ML Data & Platform Engineer
description: <p>We're looking for an ML Data & Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure that powers our speech AI models: the pipelines that source and prepare training data, and the platform that trains, evaluates, and serves them in production. production faster.</p> <p>This is a broad, cross-functional role suited to someone who enjoys working across the full stack: data infrastructure, distributed systems, and production ML, and who takes ownership of problems end to end rather than waiting to be told what to fix.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating, and storing large datasets used to train our models</li> <li>Developing and maintaining web scraping and data acquisition solutions to keep training datasets fresh, high-quality, and available at scale</li> <li>Building and operating the infrastructure that lets the ML team deploy and evaluate new models quickly, and that serves models efficiently and reliably in production</li> <li>Optimising infrastructure for both iteration speed and production reliability, including GPU utilisation, job scheduling, and training efficiency</li> <li>Implementing observability (monitoring, logging, alerting) across data pipelines and ML systems to catch issues early and keep things running smoothly</li> <li>Troubleshooting complex issues across distributed systems, spanning data infrastructure, training, and inference</li> <li>Continuously improving our data and MLOps practices, and helping shape the roadmap for how our platform evolves as we scale</li> title: Graduate - Babyzone
description: <p>Graduate Programme — Babyzone</p> <ul> <li><strong>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life? </strong></li> <li><strong>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</strong></li> <li><strong>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a tech company is built, and be supported while taking ownership of work that matters? </strong></li> </ul> <p>If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p>We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to Babyzone, one of the social-impact organisations supported by BC.</p> <p><strong>ABOUT US</strong></p> <p>At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p>Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p>We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p>Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong> IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</strong></p> <p>15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <p>ABOUT BABYZONE</p> <p>Babyzone is an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.</p> <p> <strong>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity's growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p>For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul> <li>Dedicated to Babyzone – although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.</li> <li>Training & Development – we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.</li> <li>Early Careers Development – as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.</li> <li>Graduate Community – you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.</li> <li>Accountability – you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>ARE YOU BC? </strong></p> <p>We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives. </p> <p>We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Curious </strong>– people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand ‘why’ and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’ perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.</li> <li><strong>‘Doers’ </strong>– surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.</li> <li><strong>Flexible Mindset – </strong>working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiasm – </strong>you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. A desire for doing new and challenging things makes coming into work a whole lot more fun.</li> <li><strong>Humble & Sociable </strong>– building a tech start-up is never easy. As such, we have a ‘no-ego’ policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously and look to have fun whilst doing so.</li> </ul> <p>If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE:</p> <ul> <li>Be part of the UK’s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible talent in BC</li> <li>Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Babyzone</li> <li>A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere</li> <li>Discretionary bonus</li> <li>25 days of paid holidays + your birthday off</li> <li>Life Assurance, Pension Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme</li> <li>Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental, Gym Subsidiaries</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>APPLICATION & PROCESS</strong></p> <p>If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps. We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent. </p> <p>We have a three-stage process that will consist of the following:</p> <p>Stage 1: Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent team</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Stage 2:</strong> Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities</p> <p> </p> <p>Stage 3: Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Babyzone at Scale Space, White City</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>*Please note the timeframes provided above are subject to change, which we will communicate throughout the process*</strong></p> <p><em>Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values, thus making it core to our business. We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.  This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.  You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing <a ---------- but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for. You can review our privacy policy<a href="https://www.blenheimchalcot.com/recruitment-privacy-policy/"> here</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Strategy Director, Media Strategy
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3078 - Strategy Director, Media Strategy - UK</strong></p> <p>We're seeking a strategic thinker with expertise in media effectiveness and storytelling to join our team at T&P. Your role will involve shaping client communications through insightful strategies, fostering innovation, and maintaining effective measurement processes.</p> <p>This role will include one of our integrated clients and the successful candidate will be the senior strategy practitioner. As such, it is ideally suited for a strategist who is keen to develop a broader skillset than media alone, as well as gain experience managing senior client stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Whilst your average to do list will vary from day to day, typical responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Leading strategic responses, narratives for pitches as well as delivering genuine data-driven insight to client teams</li> <li>Delivering key internal strategic workstreams, planning and insight training as well as encouraging agency creativity and innovation</li> <li>Present work in agency forums, lead agency brainstorms as well as identify and develop award entries</li> <li>Staying up to date with trends and sharing this with strategy teams alongside contributing to thought pieces and external events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>We are most interested in your ability to articulate the client’s challenge succinctly and turn that into actionable instructions for media planning teams. The skillset and experience you may have had to get to this point may vary but in general will include:</li> <ul> <li>Both ATL and Digital media channel knowledge</li> <li>The gravitas to be a trusted strategic partner to key clients</li> <li>Ability to build strong relationships across the agency</li> <li>Understanding of effectiveness best practice and a willing to improvise to deliver competitive advantage</li> <li>Most importantly, you will be curious, clear and creative in your thinking, writing and speaking.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. title: Sr. Compliance Consultant
description: About Us Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity. Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance. We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth. Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures. Position Overview We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives. This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team. Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities. As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months. If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you. What you’ll do: Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation Produce high-quality, client-ready deliverables, such as gap analyses, risk assessments, onboarding and monitoring frameworks, policies and decision papers Run workshops with client stakeholders, from compliance teams to the C-suite, turning discussion into practical next steps Horizon-scan regulation across the UK, Europe and beyond, and brief clients on what’s coming and what it means for them, directly or alongside our commercial team Advise clients on their compliance stack, testing and benchmarking providers through structured, RFP-style evaluations Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government bodies and company registers to secure access to data, expand Condukt’s global footprint and represent Condukt in industry forums Shape Condukt’s advisory proposition, identifying emerging client needs and opportunities to bring new capabilities to existing clients alongside our commercial team Partner with Product to translate regulatory and client needs into the signals, data and capabilities we build Contribute to business development and thought leadership with a clear, well-argued point of view on regulation, through proposals, client pitches, whitepapers, briefings, webinars and industry events What you bring: 4+ years’ experience in financial crime compliance, gained in a consultancy, a regulator or a regulated financial services firm Deep domain advising on vendor assessment and selection, including running or contributing to RFP processes Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, regulators and government agencies Strong commercial awareness: you can turn regulatory requirements into solutions clients see real value in A legal background, or solid working knowledge of financial regulation and how title: Principal Product Designer
description: Job Title: Principal Product Designer Avast Location: London, Hybrid (3 days in office) Portfolio: Please ensure your CV includes a link to your portfolio and a password. About Gen: We're not just a company; we're a global force. Fiercely committed to ensuring that everyone, everywhere, can live their lives digitally safe. Our family of brands, Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender and CCleaner, unite the brightest minds, the sharpest tech and the most diverse thinking to protect over 500 million people. And we've built an inclusive workplace, where your well-being is a priority because true success comes from a place of balance and authenticity. When you're thriving, you're unstoppable. So, bring us your bold ideas and passion that refuses to quit. The digital world isn't some distant reality, it's the world we live in, and we're ready for it. If you're ready to push boundaries and be part of something bigger, join #TeamGen. How We Work: Our hybrid work style (3 days in the London office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions and build relationships. And it's flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work. About the Role Help shape the future of Avast’s digital protection experience freemium experience. As a Principal Product Designer at Gen, you’ll design how people discover Avast, get value from our free products and choose to upgrade to paid protection—creating experiences that earn their trust and keep them coming back. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product design role , combining strong UX thinking with excellent visual and UI craft. You’ll take work from discovery and research through to polished, shipped experiences across mobile, desktop and web, with a clear focus on acquisition, conversion and retention . We’re looking for someone who has designed and shipped mobile-first consumer products at scale , with a portfolio showing what you personally owned, the decisions you made and the impact your work delivered. You’ll also help shape AI-powered experiences that make digital protection simpler, more useful and more personal. Working closely with product, research and engineering, you’ll influence design direction while staying close to the detail of the work. About the Team: Gen's Global Product Design team is a diverse, distributed group working across London, Prague, Dublin and the US. The global team designs across cybersecurity, identity protection, privacy and financial wellness, with a strong focus on AI-enabled experiences and reimagining key user journeys. This role sits within the cyber safety pillar, working primarily on Avast and its freemium ecosystem, while staying closely connected to the wider design community across Gen's brands. Key Responsibilities: Shape strategy through design: translate complex problems and abstract ideas into elegant, usable solutions grounded in user needs and business goals Design intelligent experiences: bring clarity and usability to AI-powered products by designing interactions that feel natural, transparent and trustworthy Turn insights into impact: translate complex problems and abstract ideas into simple, usable and delightful solutions grounded in user needs and data Prototype and test with AI: explore new possibilities through discovery, rapid prototyping and user testing, especially around how AI can simplify tasks or personalise experiences Collaborate and influence: partner across disciplines to align design outcomes with user needs, business goals and AI capabilities Champion design quality: ensure every touchpoint, whether powered by AI or not, is cohesive, accessible and human-centred About You: Education: degree in Design, HCI or a related field, or equivalent professional experience Experience: A track record of designing and shipping mobile-first B2C products at scale, ideally in industries like security, fintech, health or adjacent spaces Comfortable operating across time zones and cultures; experience with distributed teams is a plus Experience designing for or alongside AI-driven features such as personalisation, recommendations or automation is a strong plus Experience in cybersecurity or financial services is helpful, but curiosity and adaptability matter more Skills: Strategic mindset with a keen sense of how design drives user value and business growth Mastery of end-to-end product design: UX research, interaction, visual design and systems thinking Deep user empathy and a belief in data-informed design decisions Personal Attributes: Curious, adaptable and motivated by solving complex problems for real people at scale A clear, compelling portfolio that demonstrates your design process and product impact Compensation The annual base salary for this position is expected to be in the range of base salary GBP 80,000 - 100,000. Base salary is one component of Gen's total compensation package, which includes annual bonus and new hire RSU's. Actual salaries will vary based on a candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies related to the role. Benefits: At Gen Digital, we are committed to supporting our employees' well-being and professional growth. Our comprehensive benefits package for UK team members includes: Health & Wellbeing: company-paid private medical insurance, dental and vision benefits, plus access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Financial Security: a Group Personal Pension Plan with auto-enrolment for eligible employees, together with the opportunity to purchase Gen stock through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Unlimited Paid Time Off: available once statutory annual leave has been used, plus company holidays and a range of leave options to support personal and family needs Tuition Reimbursement: up to £5,150 per calendar year for job-related accredited courses that support career development within Gen Wellness Reimbursement: up to $450 per year to cover fitness-related expenses Sustainability Allowance: a $500 annual sustainable home improvement allowance Additional Perks: access to adoption assistance, family support services, legal assistance plans and exclusive employee discounts What's Next: Your CV and portfolio will be reviewed by the recruiter and hiring manager to understand the scope of your work, the impact you've delivered, and how your experience aligns with the role. If your experience aligns with what we're looking for, our recruiter will be in touch to arrange a conversation about your background, what motivates you, your interest in Gen and our products, and what to expect from the interview process. Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs. Compensation: £80K – £100K • £80K – £100K Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement
description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote. Contract: Full-time, permanent. Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe. You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on. What You'll Do Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented. Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation. Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics. Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team. Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision. Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty. Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back. Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation. Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims. Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance. Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch. What You'll Bring 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions. Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks. Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming. Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data. Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns). Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker. Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering. Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap. Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale. Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team. If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link. Why People Join Us We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first. Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world. Before You Hit Apply By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Ready to work somewhere that cares more about how you build software than how fast you can ship it? At Opencast, we don’t measure developers by the number of tickets you complete. We care about engineering craft, clean design and thoughtful problem-solving. Opencast consultants deliver in complex environments, pairing often and working with others who take pride in doing things properly: TDD, emerging design, refactoring and leaving code better than they found it. We build software we are proud of, and our clients trust us not just to code but to think, challenge and guide. If you value simple and robust solutions and want a role where your judgment matters as much as your keyboard, you will fit right in. Software developers at Opencast care about building products right and combine their own experience and approach with our company values. They are tech agnostic, have expertise in agile methodologies, extreme programming practices and use industry-leading programming languages to deliver agile transformation. Our approach to software development is collaborative, focused on keeping things simple, and we use test driven development and pair programming as best practice. Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Our developers are inclusive team players that listen, collaborate, can positively challenge and manage expectations when needed but most of all are always willing to teach and help others. Leaving a client with improved ways of working, working technology and a good experience from discovery through to live is the priority. title: Interaction Designer, HCI
description: About Act There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing. This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows. There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up. What You'll Be Doing Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks. Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting, uncertain, interrupted, failed, and recovered. Design human-in-the-loop controls - how users review AI decisions, override actions, and stay informed without micromanaging. Create interaction patterns for delegation, approval, correction, escalation, reversibility, and recovery. Create detailed interaction specifications, annotated flows, and prototypes for engineering handoff. Work with product and ML teams to translate system capabilities and constraints into usable interaction patterns. Test interaction designs with real users to identify where AI behavior creates confusion, distrust, or friction. Contribute to a shared library of HCI interaction patterns that can be reused across the product. What You Will Need Experience as an interaction designer or senior UX designer with strong interaction design depth. Ability to design at the micro level - states, transitions, edge cases, and failure handling. Strong prototyping skills in Figma or equivalent tools. Systematic thinking - able to map complex AI behavior into coherent user-facing interaction logic. Clear understanding of HCI principles: user control, transparency, feedback, and graceful recovery. Experience working closely with engineers to ensure interactions are implemented as designed. Comfort designing for systems where output is non-deterministic and behavior can vary across sessions. Strong judgment on when users should be guided, interrupted, asked for confirmation, or left alone. How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. title: Growth Product Manager - Customer Acquisition (German Speaking)
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. Hybrid in Berlin or London We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument. The team The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert. The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates. The role This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate. The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions. Own the funnel from first visit to application Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it. Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next. Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first. Build with your technical squad Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring. Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca. Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon. Be the first call when the numbers look wrong Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems. Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice. Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers. Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes. Run the experiments that decide what ships Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows. Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis. Shape how a new team works Direct the squad’s work day to day: brief the data scientist and engineers, set priorities, and turn their models into shipped products. Define the priorities, roles and rituals of a team that is still being built. Lead cross-functional initiatives with marketing and sales, aligning them with engineering and data on shared goals, hypotheses and success metrics. Turn the commercial strategy team’s goals into testable hypotheses and briefs the squad can act on. The requirements Essential: Experience as a product manager, growth product manager, or in a role with clear ownership of product-led growth outcomes. Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools. Hands-on experience with tracking and attribution setups, such as Amplitude, GA4, GTM, server-side tagging or conversion feedback into ad platforms. Able to act as the product voice on modelling work – challenging assumptions and turning model output into decisions, without building the models yourself. Strong capability using AI tools, including structured prompting and iterative AI interaction to problem solve and increase productivity. Bonus: Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products. Experience working with data science teams or involvement in modelling projects. Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments. Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products. Experience working in or helping build newly formed teams. The salary We expect to pay from £60,000 - £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Foundations Recipes
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><em>The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.</em></p> <p><em>In this hybrid role, you will report to a Senior Staff Software Engineer.</em></p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with foundation model training teams title: Diesel Mechanic
description: Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms. Job Overview We are currently seeking a skilled Diesel Mechanic to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting diesel engines and related systems on our autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Responsibilities Perform routine maintenance tasks on diesel engines, including oil changes, filter replacements, and fluid checks, to ensure proper functioning and longevity. Diagnose and repair diesel engine malfunctions, mechanical issues, and electrical faults using diagnostic tools, technical manuals, and troubleshooting techniques. Inspect and test diesel engine components, systems, and subsystems to identify and address potential problems or areas of concern. Overhaul and rebuild diesel engines and associated systems, including fuel injection systems, turbochargers, and exhaust systems, as needed to restore performance and efficiency. Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including parts used, labour hours, and service performed, to track equipment history and ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and regulatory requirements. Follow safety protocols and procedures for working with diesel engines and related equipment, including proper handling and disposal of hazardous materials and fluids. Collaborate with other maintenance technicians, engineers, and operators to troubleshoot complex problems, share technical knowledge, and implement effective solutions. Qualifications Marine Diesel and/or Volvo VODIA experience required GCSEs (or equivalent) are required. A recognised vocational qualification or apprenticeship in diesel mechanics, marine engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Proven experience as a diesel technician or a diesel mechanic, with demonstrated proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining diesel engines and related systems. Strong mechanical aptitude and technical skills, with the ability to read and interpret technical manuals, diagrams, and schematics. Familiarity with diagnostic tools and equipment used in diesel engine repair, such as scan tools, multimeters, and oscilloscopes. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical issues. Effective communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines. Ability to travel as needed to meet business objectives, including throughout the Indo-Pacific region and to our headquarters in Austin, Texas. This role will require spending 30+ days training at Saronic headquarters in Austin, Texas. Physical Demands Ability to perform physically demanding work for extended periods. Frequently and repetitively lift, push, and carry up to 23 kg's. Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in marine and waterside environments. Frequently and repetitively bend, lift, and reach to install and remove components of varying size and weight. Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, including over varied and uneven terrain such as docks, vessel decks, and gravel surfaces. Stoop, lay, bend, reach, squat, kneel, crouch, twist, and crawl for extended periods while working in confined or low-clearance spaces. Climb and maintain balance on ladders, platforms, vessels, and other elevated structures. Exposure to loud noise, vibration, engine exhaust, and hazardous materials with required adherence to safety and disposal procedures. Wear Personal Protective Equipment at all times in work areas, including safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other PPE as required. Benefits Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success Competitive Salary: Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses Medical Insurance: Comprehensive private health insurance Time Off: Generous annual leave entitlement, plus public holidays. Parental Leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents This role requires the legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Employment may also be subject to applicable security, export control, and government contracting requirements. If this role is based in the United States, it requires access to export-controlled information or items that require “U.S. Person” status. description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. You’ll also advise on marketing, referral and partnership initiatives, helping the business move quickly while managing legal and regulatory risk. Provide clear, pragmatic advice on UK and relevant EMEA legal and regulatory requirements, helping teams navigate applicable rules while enabling responsible growth. Support Corporate Development on fundraising rounds and strategic transactions, including due diligence, data rooms, corporate approvals, investment documentation, cap table changes and ongoing governance. Partner with the business, Regulatory Legal and Regulatory Compliance teams on expansion into and launches in new markets across the UK and EMEA, including regulatory mapping, entity and licensing considerations, and corporate governance requirements. Align Airwallex’s policies, procedures and corporate governance frameworks across jurisdictions, with particular focus on UK requirements. Draft, review and negotiate referral agreements, marketing and sponsorship agreements, and other commercial arrangements, ensuring risks are appropriately managed and documented. Advise on marketing, advertising and promotions, including claims, disclosures, digital campaigns, co-marketing and referral programmes, while supporting the review of customer-facing materials for legal and regulatory compliance. Coordinate and manage outside counsel on specialised matters in the UK and across EMEA, ensuring advice is high-quality, cost-effective and aligned to Airwallex’s risk appetite and business goals. Use technology and AI-enabled tools, including templates, playbooks, contract lifecycle tools and knowledge bases, to increase the speed, consistency and quality of legal work. You’ll work from our London office three days a week. Demonstrated interest in financial services regulation and the fintech industry, with willingness to go deep on payments, e-money, money services and related regulatory topics in the UK and EMEA. In-depth knowledge of, or strong familiarity with, the UK legal and business environment, including how UK legislation, FCA requirements and cross-border rules impact fintech and payments businesses. Proven experience drafting and negotiating corporate and commercial agreements, with strong written and verbal communication skills that make complex issues clear to non-lawyers. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Compliance, Risk and Marketing, across time zones. Demonstrated capability in managing and leading outside counsel, including scoping work, controlling costs and consolidating advice into clear recommendations. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a practical, business-oriented approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Preferred Experience supporting fundraising transactions, M&A or strategic investments, including due diligence and deal execution, ideally in a technology or fintech context. Prior in-house experience in a fintech, payments or broader financial services company, particularly one operating across the UK and multiple EMEA jurisdictions. Experience advising on legal issues related to marketing, advertising and promotions, including digital marketing, performance marketing, referral programmes and brand partnerships. Exposure to UK financial services regulatory frameworks, including the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000, the Payment Services Regulations 2017, the Electronic Money Regulations 2011, FCA rules and guidance, and applicable financial promotions requirements. Experience partnering with Regulatory Legal, Regulatory Compliance or licensing teams on market expansion initiatives and regulatory change. Comfort using technology, AI and legal operations tools to increase the speed and quality of legal work, for example playbooks, templates, contract lifecycle tools or knowledge bases. This team backs the builders transforming us into a generational financial company, working alongside product, sales, and business partners every step of the way. You'll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while keeping our brand and data architecture best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the discipline that protects the moat. It's a team for lawyers, strategists, and licensing specialists with commercial instincts, sharp judgment, and an obsession with customer-first outcomes. If you want to guide executive decisions and help build the licensing, structure, and judgment behind what comes next, this is where legal has real leverage. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact. We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age. By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients. The opportunity Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to work in close partnership with our Programme and Project Leaders, putting you in a prime position to help shape delivery plans and drive our osteoporosis programme forward. Working across the full discovery journey, you'll help move the programme through Target ID, Hit-to-Lead, Lead Optimisation, Candidate Selection and beyond — coordinating across the multiple projects that make up the programme, our internal interdisciplinary teams, and third-party partners such as CROs, all while navigating the ambiguity of discovery-stage science with confidence. You'll operate at programme level, with visibility across every project within the osteoporosis programme, partnering with the Programme Leader and the Project Leaders who own each individual project. If this sounds like you, and you thrive in matrixed environments and want a real hand in shaping how tomorrow's medicines are discovered, come and join us in the heart of London. Orchestrate the matrix team to deliver against project objectives, motivating all team members with clear direction and communication. title: Tech Lead
description: We’re on a mission to protect society from fraud and money laundering. We’ve already protected over 3 million people through life’s big transactions. Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering. Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud. Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking. Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over \$33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel. You won’t be responsible for line management, but you will be expected to set direction, raise standards, and take ownership of the technical outcomes for your area. About the team: Our engineering teams are cross-functional product teams , made up of engineers with different specialisms working closely with Product Managers, Designers and stakeholders across the business. We focus on delivering value iteratively while maintaining a high bar for quality, security and reliability. Design, build and deliver complex features and systems that are secure, scalable and maintainable. Own technical outcomes end-to-end, from discovery and design through to delivery and long-term operation. Lead by example in AI-assisted software engineering, using AI to accelerate delivery while maintaining strong engineering judgement and accountability for the resulting software. Help the team continuously improve its AI-enabled development practices and identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work. Represent Engineering at an organisational level, partnering with stakeholders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Support, Operations, Legal and Compliance to shape decisions, manage trade-offs and drive successful technical outcomes. Mentor and coach engineers across the team, supporting their technical growth and confidence. Set a high bar for code quality, testing, observability and operational excellence. Collaborate closely with Product and Design to shape solutions, challenge assumptions and manage trade-offs. Lead technical discussions, reviews and incident investigations, helping the team learn and improve. Contribute to wider engineering initiatives and influence standards across the technology organisation. You can communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving, regulated environment where quality and trust are critical. We use and teach: We’re passionate about supporting your growth and giving you opportunities to work across the stack. Our Benefits: We've created our benefits package to reflect Thirdfort's mission and values. Everything we do is designed to build on trust , and we extend this promise to our team by investing in their physical, mental, and financial security to support them through life's big moments. Ultimately, our benefits exist to empower our people, ensuring everyone feels deeply supported, trusted, and equipped to do their best work. When you join Thirdfort, you'll get immediate access to our employee benefits package that aims to support you across these areas: Compensation: £100,000 + Share options for all UK employees Annual leave allowance of 26 days, increasing to 30 with tenure and the option to buy additional days Uncapped personal development budget Flexible working hours Private healthcare (AXA) Enhanced parental and sick leave We're committed to building an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture where everyone has a chance to make a difference. We're purposefully building a team of problem-solvers that reflect our values, which is why we hire from all backgrounds. If you're a curious, kind individual who takes ownership, you'll be a great Thirdforter. title: Forward Deployed Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era.
